Ladakh is witnessing protests against the decision to hold Hill Council elections during the harsh winter months.
With temperatures dropping below -30C in several areas, local leaders are questioning the timing of the December elections.
Sonam Wangchuk has appealed to President Droupadi Murmu, PM Narendra Modi and Home Minister Amit Shah to intervene.
The protests also bring back questions over the September 24, 2025 violence, in which four people lost their lives.
